user.title: Set up Energy Appliance Scheduler
user.description: Select the Energy Storage Control entities and configure Alexa devices, quiet hours and output volume. The settings form opens directly without an additional confirmation page.

data_description.price_sensor: Use the ESC current-price sensor. Price data is required for favorable-phase starts and is only informational for fixed-time starts; a missing price never blocks a fixed-time start.
data_description.alexa_media_players: Activation, plan changes, cancellation, start and errors are spoken on these devices.
data_description.alexa_quiet_hours_enabled: During quiet hours, messages remain in the Home Assistant log but are not spoken on Alexa devices.
data_description.alexa_quiet_hours_start: Time from which Alexa output is suppressed. The interval may cross midnight.
data_description.alexa_quiet_hours_end: Time at which Alexa output resumes.
data_description.alexa_volume_percent: Before each message, the selected Alexa devices are set to this volume. The device volume remains at this level afterwards.

alexa_texts.title: Alexa texts
alexa_texts.description: The default texts are ready to use and may be edited. Supported placeholder names: device, program, program_phrase, start_date, start_time, price, schedule and error.

error.quiet_hours_identical: The start and end of Alexa quiet hours must be different.

user.title: Add appliance
user.description: Create a real Home Assistant device. A program entity is optional. No input helpers are created.

data_description.program_entity: Select a select or input_select entity whose options should be exposed by this integration.
data_description.program_behavior: Choose whether program selection prepares the appliance before separate start actions, or whether selecting the program itself starts the appliance.

controls.title: Start and operating-state control
controls.description: Configure the native Home Assistant actions and, optionally, an entity that confirms the appliance is running.

data_description.prepare_actions: For example, switch the appliance on before selecting its program.
data_description.start_actions: Required unless selecting the configured program starts the appliance.
data_description.running_states: Comma-separated, for example: on,running,active. State comparison is case-insensitive.
data_description.start_confirmation_timeout: After the start command, wait this long for a running state. Authorization is cleared after the command in all cases.

reconfigure.title: Edit appliance
reconfigure.description: Change the appliance name, icon and optional program source.

reconfigure_controls.title: Edit start and operating-state control
reconfigure_controls.description: Change actions, the optional operating-state entity and start confirmation.

error.invalid_actions: At least one action is invalid or incomplete.
